description: Multi-tenant electronic medical record (EMR) platform for residential addiction and behavioral-health treatment programs. Provides bed management, episode-based clinical records, a documentation builder, consent management, and a tamper-evident audit log.
authorization_boundary: AWS: CloudFront (edge) -> Application Load Balancer -> ECS Fargate (Flask/Python API) -> RDS PostgreSQL in an isolated subnet with no internet route. Static frontend bundle served from S3 via Origin Access Control. Secrets in AWS Secrets Manager; encryption via four customer-managed KMS keys.
data_types: Protected Health Information (PHI), HIPAA Security Rule
Substance Use Disorder records, 42 CFR Part 2
hosting: Amazon Web Services (ECS Fargate, RDS Multi-AZ, CloudFront, S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, Route 53)
categorization: FIPS 199 provisional: Confidentiality = High, Integrity = Moderate, Availability = Moderate (driven by PHI and 42 CFR Part 2 substance use disorder records). Overall impact: High.
system_type: Major application - multi-tenant SaaS electronic medical record
authorizing_official: Not applicable - demonstration system; the system owner acts as the approving authority
applicable_laws: 42 CFR Part 2 (Confidentiality of Substance Use Disorder Patient Records)
ONC Health IT Certification criteria (45 CFR 170.315)
guidance: NIST SP 800-66 Rev 2 (Implementing the HIPAA Security Rule: A Cybersecurity Resource Guide)
assessment_framework_note: Aeglero's binding obligations are the laws and regulations listed above. NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 is not itself a legal requirement for this system (Aeglero processes PHI, not federal CUI); it is used as the assessment framework because it is rigorous and quantifiable (SPRS-scored) and its control set crosswalks cleanly to HIPAA, ONC, CMMC, and 42 CFR Part 2. Using 800-171 as the common spine demonstrates compliance automation that maps a single control set across multiple frameworks and industries.
assessment_scope_note: Aeglero is a HIPAA-scoped healthcare system; its real regulatory obligation is HIPAA + 42 CFR Part 2. This document maps Aeglero's existing controls to NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 to DEMONSTRATE continuous-compliance automation. Aeglero is not a federal CUI system and this is not an official assessment artifact.
